description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Warden of the Eye, adding {B}.
When Warden of the Eye dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Warden of the Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Warden of the Eye.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kaya's Ghostform
uses.cardState: attached to Warden of the Eye
